title: Multimodal deep learning separates benign and malignant renal tumours on ultrasound
summary: Model-UT combined ResNet50 image features, BERT text encoding and a ViT multimodal classifier on ultrasound images and clinical-ultrasound texts of 1,008 patients (740 training, 186 validation, 82 prospective test). In the validation set it achieved the highest AUC among the models, 0.89. The prospective test set is small and from a single centre; its AUC is not given here.
ai_technology: ResNet50 image features, BERT text encoding and ViT multimodal classifier
organization: Fudan University; Zhongshan Hospital; MedAI Technology

evidence.tested: Diagnostic performance in a validation set and an independent prospective test set of 82 patients.
evidence.unknown: Single centre; small prospective set; clinical benefit not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Multimodal deep learning combining ultrasound images and clinical text.
